narration: This is your body after twenty four hours with no sleep.

Hour twelve: cortisol spikes — you are running on pure stress hormone. Hour seventeen: your reaction time drops to the level of legal drunkenness. And by hour twenty: micro-sleeps begin. Your brain shuts off for seconds, without asking you.
After nineteen hours awake, your brain performs like zero point zero five percent blood alcohol.
